flawed_step: The claim assumes that choosing the largest available denomination at each step always leads to a globally minimum coin count.
counterexample: Denominations {1,3,4}, amount 6. Greedy takes 4, then 1, then 1, using 3 coins. But 3+3=6 uses only 2 coins, so greedy is not optimal.
assessment_summary: This explicit coin system contains a 1-unit coin and satisfies all definitions, but the greedy algorithm does not use the fewest coins.
